name: Ischigualasto / Talampaya Natural Parks
description: Set in the dry western edge of central Argentina, these two neighbouring desert parks cover about 275,000 hectares of rock and badlands. Their layered rock formations hold the most complete fossil record of the Triassic anywhere on land, from 245 to 208 million years ago. Early dinosaurs, forerunners of mammals and ancient plants are preserved here, showing how life on land evolved.
